mapper.sql: id, parent_id, dept_code, dept_name, path, level, sort_order, leader_user_id, status, remark, source_type, tenant_key, external_id, last_synced_at, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_department WHERE deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY level, sort_order, id
SELECT FROM sys_department WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_department SET parent_id = #{parentId}, dept_code = #{deptCode}, dept_name = #{deptName}, path = #{path}, level = #{level}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, leader_user_id = #{leaderUserId}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0

UPDATE sys_department SET path = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), level = level + #{levelDelta}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPrefix}, '%')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id WHERE d.path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%') AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND u.deleted_at = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_department_scope s INNER JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = s.department_id WHERE d.path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%') AND d.deleted_at = 0 AND s.deleted_at = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_department SET status = 0, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{path}, '%') AND deleted_at = 0
